description: Divisional Secretariat - Mahiyanganaya - Orders made with regard to the Camp of Mahiyangana Esala Festival - 2016 which will be commended from 02.09.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the administration and regulations for a religious/cultural festival (Esala Festival of Mahiyangana). It covers logistical arrangements, camp area specifications, trading permissions, and public health measures. This content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the specialized categories (4-9) as it is not primarily about land, legal, commercial, electoral, public service, or judicial matters. It falls under miscellaneous administrative matters related to cultural/religious event management.
